hero.title: Angels Care School
hero.subheading: Educating refugee children in Kyaka II to be the leaders of tomorrow.
hero.intro: Despite severe resource constraints and an average of 120 eager students per class, our nursery and primary schools achieve the highest nationwide exam performance across the entire refugee settlement region.

students.label: Active Refugee Scholars
students.detail: Receiving free or heavily subsidized academic tuition, uniforms, learning materials, and diagnostic health checkups.

ratio.label: Average Class Ratio
ratio.detail: Demonstrating the extreme crowding and the profound dedication of our local teachers instructing large cohorts daily.

rank.label: Exams Performance
rank.detail: Leading the settlement district in regional and national primary school assessment metrics for successive terms.

needs.title: Current Operational Resource Demands
needs.description: Angels Care operates entirely through small individual sponsorships and partner grants. Here are our most immediate operational funding targets:

items.title: Teacher Salary Sponsorship
items.description: Fund the complete monthly living stipend of a registered Ugandan primary teacher on campus.

items.title: Porridge Feeding Fund
items.description: Provide hot, vitamin-fortified maize porridge at daily morning assemblies as critical nutrition.

items.title: Posho & Beans Meal Support
items.description: Guarantee warm daily lunches of posho (maize meal) and beans to prevent acute classroom malnutrition.

items.title: School Uniform & Footwear
items.description: Provide a complete standard navy-blue school uniform, replacement shirt, and protective leather shoes.

items.title: Ex-Books & Learning Material
items.description: Purchase a comprehensive set of exercise ledger papers, pencils, slate boards, rubber erasers, and ruler kits.

curriculum.title: Cultivating Deep Intellectual Growth
curriculum.description: We strictly adhere to the standardized primary education curriculum prescribed by the Ugandan Ministry of Education and Sports, supplemented with peace-building and trauma recovery circles designed for conflict survivors.
list: Multilingual Refugee Speech Circle (English, French, Swahili)
Youth Creative Performing Arts, Sports & Choir Assemblies

advocacy.title: Eliminating Girls’ Absenteeism Series
advocacy.description: An essential element of our education model focuses on Girls’ Education and Hygiene care: supplying sanitary kits, safety lockers, separate privacy washing quarters, and reusable menstrual shields.
advocacy.quote: “When we equip our female scholars with proper hygiene supplies, they remain in the classroom, breaking the poverty loop.”
